headline: Skyrizi and Rinvoq carry the quarter as Humira erosion fades
summary_short: AbbVie's Q2 2026 net revenue of $16.99B rose 10.2% y/y (9.5% operational) as Skyrizi (+24.4%) and Rinvoq (+24.5%) growth outran Humira's -35.9% biosimilar erosion. Adjusted diluted EPS was $3.65, up 22.9% y/y.
summary_long: Immunology led at $8.79B (+15.1%), with Skyrizi and Rinvoq both accelerating past +24% while Humira continued its biosimilar decline to $756M. Neuroscience revenue rose 20.3% to $3.23B on Vraylar, Botox Therapeutic, Ubrelvy and Qulipta. Oncology slipped 1.5% as Imbruvica's -29.4% erosion outweighed Venclexta and Elahere gains. Aesthetics was roughly flat. GAAP diluted EPS of $2.03 (vs $0.52) benefited from lapping a much larger prior-year IPR&D/milestone charge. AbbVie announced a definitive agreement to acquire Apogee Therapeutics (~$10.9B equity value, immunology bolt-on, expected Q3 2026 close) and updated FY2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance to $13.87-$14.07 (from $13.91-$14.11), reflecting $0.14 of Apogee-related dilution partially offset by $0.10 of overperformance.

drivers.explanation: Immunology growth from Skyrizi (+24.4%) and Rinvoq (+24.5%) and Neuroscience +20.3% more than offset Humira's -35.9% biosimilar erosion.
Q2 2025 included a much larger acquired IPR&D and milestones charge ($823M) than Q2 2026's $291M, inflating the y/y EPS comparison.
Imbruvica's -29.4% decline outweighed growth in Venclexta (+11.6%) and Elahere (+33.1%).
Company announced a definitive agreement to acquire Apogee Therapeutics, expected to close Q3 2026, deepening the immunology pipeline.
